name: YouTube Video Parser

meta.description: Cheapest YouTube reader: captions when available, public metadata when they are not. One method, get_youtube_video. Needs youtube_transcript_api.

manifest.title: YouTube Video Parser
manifest.author: alex
manifest.description: Reads a YouTube video and returns captions/transcript with a fallback to public metadata.

specs.name: get_youtube_video
specs.description:
Read a YouTube video and return captions/transcript when available.
Use this whenever the user provides a YouTube URL or video ID and wants
the spoken content, transcript, or a summary of what happens in the video.

url.description: YouTube watch, shorts, embed, or youtu.be URL, or a bare video ID
